title: 6 Diwali Releases, Ranked by Critics
headline: 6 Diwali Releases, Ranked by Critics
caption:
Ramayana: Part 1 tops idly's Diwali table at 6.9/10, 0.6 ahead of Suriya's Scene; they are the only two of the six ranked films to clear 6/10. Mookuthi Amman 2 comes last at 3.6.

Score: the mean of numeric ratings from idly's fixed panel of 47 Indian English-language outlets (newspapers, TV and news sites, established film publications), published on or after release and confirmed on the outlet's page or in two independent listings, converted to /10. A film needs 4; Pyre (2) and Nakhrewaalii (0) fell short, so they are not ranked.

Ramayana: Part 1 leads Scene by 0.6: which of the six are you booking first, and what tipped it?

Sources: 60 ratings from 123Telugu, Cinema Express, DNA, DT Next, Deccan Chronicle, Deccan Herald, Filmfare, Firstpost, Great Andhra, Gulte, Hindustan Times, India TV, India Today, Indian Express, Koimoi, NDTV, New Indian Express, News18, OnlyKollywood, Outlook, Pinkvilla, Rediff, Telugu360, The Week and Times of India; read on the outlets' pages or in thereviewmonk, Rotten Tomatoes, Sacnilk and BollyMovieReviewz.

self.notes: alone 1: Pyre and Nakhrewaalii are not ranked because their ratings could not be confirmed under the rule (tool limits, not the films), which a reader may find odd even with the note. Six films, 60 ratings.
